notes.title: Update September 6th 2021
notes.notes:
Happy Labor day weekend my Dudes! Here is another batch of updates I'm happy to get out to everyone :D


 Calibrated additional items and made pictures grabbable.
 Fixed issue with collision boxes not following destructibles and staying up when destroyed.
 Fixed issue where bow couldn't be dropped.
 Significantly increased fidelity of Whiteboard and Marker accuracy by changing the collision channel and removing the cast on tick.
 Added collision boxes to Whiteboard's Eraser and Marker's for easier pickup.
 Fixed the issue with the media texture not working in streaming levels.
 Added Televisions! You can cycle though the channels and see different videos. This is just version 1.0 so much more to come.
 Fixed issue with hands not detecting overlapping Actors, this significantly increased fidelity and accuracy of grabbing items.


You can keep track of what I'm currently working on The Desert's Rose Trello Board here!: 
https://trello.com/b/ejbu9xEy/the-deserts-rose

notes.title: Update July 20th 2021
notes.notes:
Hey Guys!

I've been working on going through each item in the game and calibrating them to be more/less breakable. Along with that I also changed the damage threshold of some items. I'll probably have to do another round of calibration but for now its working much better.

Here is a list of the things included in this patch:

 Added new main menu!
 Fixed issue with items floating away sometimes when grabbing.
 Refactored BaseItem and BaseHand (fixes general grabbing issues and more organized)
 Modified weapons to enable CCD on pickup (this fixes issues with the weapons sometimes going through items)
 Changed some items to use static mesh (some items did not break anyway so this is much more efficient).
 Implemented grabbing static mesh items.
 Fixed issue where items would sometimes break when colliding with yourself.
 Fixed issue with level transitions.
 Adjusted item on item collision to work better.
 Re-calibration of all items in the game including their collision bounds, their collision settings, and break-ability.
 Fixed issue where you would sometimes lag when looking.

notes.title: New Update (June 4th 2020)
notes.notes:
I added more to the town along with new Guns and Weapons. There is now a Weapon Store where you can find new weapons. 

This update also changed some things behind the scene that you might notice. For Example, I added Level Streaming which allows the game to unload levels you leave and load levels you are entering. For example, when you leave the main house and walk into town, it unloads everything inside the house. This improves performance significantly and will allow us to create more detailed levels and interiors. 

I'm continuing to work on the town and I've recently found some tools that will help with this. I really want to focus on some bugs or general querky-ness however I think AI and enemy spawning should probably be next. I want to implement good AI logic which involves using this system called "Blackboard". It allows the AI to do things like: retreat, run, hide, hunt, etc. Also the enemies at first will be "dumb" but as you kill/destroy more and more of them they will become more skilled and intelligent. 

Thanks again for the support and I look forward to providing more content ASAP.

notes.title: 11-29-2018 Update
notes.notes:
Hey All!

I'm currently working on adding an Arcade and a Weapon Store in the game. The weapon store will have real guns and many other swords and things I can think of. The Arcade is going to be a fun place to hang out in and play some VR mini games I'm also working on. One of the things for the arcade I want to do is get the lighting right so it feels like an arcade, same thing for the weapon store.

I got hired by my first VR company in October! I love working on VR and I love the company, I'm really enjoying the work. This is why I haven't had the time to push updates as often as I'd like. 

I've been reading any and all feedback I'm getting and making notes. Updates will be coming regularly so stay tuned and keep the suggestions coming ːsteamhappyː
